'''TX-38''' was located on [[Tilnes]], a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].

==History==
During the [[Rise of the Empire era]], [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Raik Muun]] took a group of captured workers to TX-38. It was a deserted factory at that time.

{{Struct-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
"TX-38" is most likely a reference to Lucas' first movie [[Wikipedia:THX 1138|THX 1138]].
